summary: Data analyst with 7+ years of experience applying R, Power BI, Excel, Power Query, SQL, and DAX to operational, customer, financial, CRM, and program data. Experienced in recurring KPI reporting, data validation, methodology documentation, root-cause analysis, and translating findings into clear recommendations for technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Recent DFPS research experience and a Professional MBA in Data Analytics in progress.

experience.title: Research Specialist I, Analytical Projects Team
experience.organization: Texas Department of Family and Protective Services (DFPS)
experience.details:
•	Used R to analyze initial CANS assessments and 24-month placement histories, demonstrating measurable associations between early domain scores and subsequent placement instability.
•	Built Power BI and Excel visualizations, validated analytical outputs, and translated findings across age groups and assessment domains into decision-ready evidence for agency leaders.
•	Findings prompted follow-on agency analyses of whether T3C provider credentialing and least-restrictive placement practices influence placement-stability outcomes.
